input: Find junior golf camps and clinics for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: First Tee – Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Youth golf summer camps listed for 2026; regional programs also serve Waynesville.

candidates.name: Springdale Golf
candidates.note: Junior golf camps cover golf skills, etiquette and sportsmanship; 2027 dates are forthcoming.

candidates.name: Country Club of Asheville
candidates.note: Summer junior instruction follows a supervised practice-and-play schedule.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Golf camp teaches swings and scoring through visits to WNC courses; loaner clubs provided.
